title: About
tagline: A cross-platform Git desktop client with a visual commit graph and conflict resolution.
description: Git Desktop is a free and open-source Git client built for people who want to see what their repository is actually doing: a real commit graph, hunk-level staging, a side-by-side conflict editor, and stash management — without a subscription and without an account.
supportHint: It is built in the open and in spare time. Starring the repository, reporting a bug you hit, or sending a pull request all help more than you would think.
credits: Built with Electron, React and simple-git. Colour palette: Catppuccin. © 2026 Mykhailo Bovtriuk.
